source: 628 Terrifying Dream
target: 628 Somnium Terribile

source: Lumian vaguely noticed bubbles emerging from the pitch‐black liquid enveloping most of the blood‐colored Demon’s body.
target: Lumian vagiter animadvertit bullas emergentes ex nigerrimo liquore, quod plerumque corpus daemonis sanguineo colore tincti circumferebat.

source: The brownish‐green hue of the bubbles resembled tree warts.
target: Color virido–brunneus bullarum ad verrucas arborum similis videbatur.

source: In an instant, the bubbles burst, reflecting brilliant colors as they merged with the pitch‐black liquid.
target: In uno momento bullae corruperunt, praeclaros colores effingentes, dum cum nigerrimo liquore confluere videbantur.

source: For some reason, Lumian sensed that something was wrong.
target: Quacumque re, Lumian sensit aliquid male esse.

source: He wished to shut his eyes and avoid these details, but trapped in a dream, he had no control.
target: Vellet oculos clausos habere et haec vitare, sed in somnio captus nullam habebat potestatem.

source: In the depths of the pitch‐black liquid, a figure lurked.
target: In profundis liquoris nigerrimi, figura insidiabatur.

source: It raised its head slightly, gazing at the blood‐colored Demon.
target: Levis caput attollens, ad daemonem sanguineo colore spectabat.

source: Moist brownish‐green or light brown tree warts protruded from the figure’s body, reminding Lumian of Susanna Mattise in her Fallen Tree Spirit state.
target: Ex corpore figurae verrucae arborum, sive virido–brunneae sive pallide brunnea, humidae emerserunt, quae Lumian ad Susannam Mattise in statu spiritus arboris lapsi revocaverunt.

source: The distinction lay in Susanna Mattise’s tree warts, branches, and flower buds growing from her body, melding with her original form.
target: Differentia consistit in verrucis arborum, ramis, et gemmis floriferis ex corpore eius crescente, quae cum forma originali coniungebantur.

source: The figure’s tree warts, however, seemed to pierce out flamboyantly from the flesh and internal organs, tainted with blood.
target: Verrucae figurae tamen ex carne et internis organis effulgentes apparere videbantur, sanguine tinctae.

source: In his dream, Lumian instinctively raised his right hand, wiping the corners of his eyes.
target: In somnio, Lumian instanter dextram manum attollit, angulos oculorum suorum delens.

source: The back of his hand was stained red.
target: Dorsum manus eius rubro tinctum erat.

source: At some point, blood had flowed from his eyes, turning his vision a blurry red.
target: Aliquando, sanguis ex oculis eius effusus est, visionem eius in rubrum nebulosum vertens.

source: The figure’s overall outline appeared in the blur.
target: Linea generalis figurae in turbatione apparuit.

source: As if grown on a brownish‐green tree, pierced by branches, overrun by tree warts, and covered in flower buds, dripping with a viscous liquid.
target: Velut in arbore virido–brunneosa crescebat, ramis perforata, verrucis abundans, et gemmis floriferis operta, liquore viscoso stillante.

source: A burning sensation engulfed Lumian’s chest, prompting him to instinctively close his eyes in the dream.
target: Sensus ardens pectus Lumiani invasebat, eumque instanter in somnio oculos claudere compellens.

source: Yet, he was a step too slow.
target: Attamen, passum nimis tardus erat.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Lumian’s eyes exploded, flooding his mind with searing pain.
target: Oculi Lumiani eruperunt, mentem eius acerrima dolore inundantes.

source: He jolted awake, curling up in agony.
target: Subito evigilavit, in dolore convolutus.

source: His hands instinctively reached for his eyes, encountering a flat, sticky, and moist substance.
target: Manus eius instanter ad oculos pervenire conarunt, et substantiā plana, adhaerente, et humida occurrerunt.

source: The scent of blood hung heavily in the air.
target: Odor sanguinis graviter in aere pendebat.

source: As an Ascetic accustomed to severe injuries, Lumian took several minutes to overcome the pain that threatened to render him unconscious.
target: Ut asceticus gravibus vulneribus assuetus, Lumian paucis minutis dedicavit ad dolorem superandum, qui eum in inconscientiam demittere minabatur.

source: Struggling to sit up, he opened his eyes, only to be met with absolute darkness.
target: Dum surgere conabatur, oculos aperuit, sed invenerat tenebras absolutas.

source: No crimson moonlight, no outlines of furniture in the bedroom–he couldn’t see a thing.
target: Nec luna rubra fulgebat, nec lineamenta supellectilis in cubiculo erant—nihil videbat.

source: Lumian raised his hand once more, gently touching his eye sockets.
target: Lumian manum iterum attollit, orbita oculorum sua leniter tangens.

source: Both eyeballs had deflated, shattered beyond repair.
target: Ambos bulbos oculi deflati erant, ultra reparari non potentes.

source: Is it because I glimpsed something I shouldn’t have? Lumian chuckled in self‐deprecation.
target: Num quia aliquid intuens videram, quod videre non deberam? Lumian, se ipsum vituperans, subridens respondit.

source: It was a vision from a dream, something he never wished to witness.
target: Erat visio ex somnio, aliquid quod numquam videre voluerat.

source: Upon reflection, he realized that if Mr. Fool’s seal hadn’t triggered or Termiboros hadn’t activated it, his eyes might not have been the only casualties.
target: Reflecto, intellexit: nisi sigillum Domini Stulti excitum esset aut Termiboros eum non activasset, oculi eius non solum laesiones patiri debuissent.

source: Wiping the tip of his nose, Lumian felt moistness and caught the unmistakable scent of rust.
target: Naris terens, Lumian humiditatem sensit et odor ferrugineus inconfusus cepit.

source: In a surprisingly good mood, he quipped, “Luckily, it seems what’s flowing down is blood, not brain matter.”
target: In animo pro certo laeto, iocose inquit: “Felix, videtur quod deorsum fluens sanguis sit, non materia cerebri.”

source: He rejoiced in surviving the ordeal.
target: Gaudebat quod periculum superaverat.

source: Despite the tragic state of his head, Lumian’s body remained relatively unharmed, albeit a bit drained.
target: Non obstante tragoedia capitis eius, corpus Lumiani relative intactum permansit, quamquam paulo exhauritum.

source: Gripping the edge of the bed, Lumian pulled himself up.
target: Latus lecti prehendens, Lumian se erexit.

source: In a state of blindness and impaired smell, he relied on the Hunter’s instinct, navigating through his turf with a mental map.
target: In caecitate et olfactu debilitato, ad instinctum Venatoris confugit, per terram suam mente delineata iter faciens.

source: Bypassing furniture, he reached the living room and knocked on the servant’s door.
target: Supellectilem praeteriens, ad conclave pervenit et ianuam servi pulsavit.

source: “Yes, what’s the matter?” Startled, Lugano hastily opened the door, dressed in a cotton shirt and underpants that served as makeshift pajamas, fearing a repeat of the terrifying encounter with Father Montserrat.
target: “Ita, quid agitur?” Perterrito, Lugano festinanter ianuam aperuit, indutus camisiae cotoni et subbraccis, quae ut temporaria pyjama fungebantur, metuens ne iterum incubi terribiles cum Patre Montserrat occurrerent.

source: Under the crimson moonlight, he saw Lumian’s blood‐streaked face and empty blood‐red eyes filled with shattered fragments.
target: Sub luna rubra, vidit faciem Lumiani sanguine striatam et oculos rubros vacuos, fractis particulis implutos.

source: “Wh-what happened?” Lugano stammered, bewildered.
target: “Quid accidit?” titubante, Lugano obstupescens inquit.

source: Who had beaten his employer to such a state?
target: Quis dominum eius ad talem statum percussit?

source: Who could inflict such harm upon his employer?
target: Quis tali laesione dominum eius laedere posset?

source: Why not teleport away from this perilous situation?
target: Cur non statim e hac periculosa re discesseret?

source: Lumian calmly pointed at his eyes.
target: Lumian placide ad oculos suos demonstravit.

source: “Treat them.”
target: Cura eas.

source: “Alright,” Lugano responded subconsciously, then added awkwardly, “With the eyeballs in such a state, there’s no way of treatment. We can only find a suitable transplant.”
target: “Recte,” Lugano subconscius respondit, deinde inepte addens: “Cum bulbi oculi tali statu sint, curae via nulla existit. Tantum substitutum opportunum inveniendum est.”

source: Lumian, enduring the pain, calmly stated, “No need. Just stop the bleeding and ease the pain.”
target: Lumian, dolorem ferens, placide dixit: “Nihil est opus; sola sanguinis effusio sistere et dolor leniendus.”

source: “Alright.” Lugano didn’t dare argue, following his employer’s instructions.
target: “Recte.” Lugano non ausus est dissentire, praecepta domini sequens.

source: He extended his shimmering left palm.
target: Manum sinistram nitidam extendit.

source: Upon contact and a simple use of a scalpel, Lumian felt a refreshing sensation in his eyes.
target: Contactu et simplici scalpro usus, Lumian sensum refrigerii in oculis sensit.

source: The pain became more bearable, though his vision remained absent.
target: Dolor levior factus est, quamvis visio eius absens manebat.

source: “You can go back to sleep,” Lumian waved dismissively, as if his loss of vision was inconsequential.
target: “Redi ad somnum,” Lumian leviter exclamavit, quasi amissus visus nihil rei esset.

source: With one hand in his pocket, he strolled past the Dutanese textbook on the carpet, settled into a recliner, and rocked it gently.
target: Una manu in sinu, per librum Dutanensem in tapete positum ambulo, in lectum reclinatorem consedit, atque leniter eum oscillavit.

source: Lugano watched in confusion and anxiety for a while before attempting to return to bed, unable to fall asleep.
target: Lugano per aliquod tempus, in confusione et sollicita animo, observavit, antequam tentaret ad lectum redire, dormitum non ferens.

source: When the morning sun bathed the sea’s edge, the Doctor abruptly rose from his bed, deciding to grab a cup of coffee for a pick‐me‐up.
target: Cum sol matutinus limen maris illustravit, Medicus subito ex lecto surrexit, poculum caffeae capere decrevit ad animos reficiendos.

source: Upon leaving the room, he witnessed his employer in motion.
target: Exiens ex conclavi, dominum suum in motu conspexit.

source: Lumian’s green eyes sparkled, showing no signs of injury.
target: Oculi virides Lumiani micabant, nullas laesiones indicantes.

source: “Y-you’re alright?” Lugano was bewildered.
target: “Bene es?” Lugano, obstupescens, inquit.

source: Lumian responded with a radiant smile, “That’s right.”
target: Lumian radianti risu respondit: “Ita est.”

source: “…” Lugano was momentarily speechless.
target: “…” Lugano paulisper mutus fuit.

source: How did my employer regenerate his eyeballs?
target: Quomodo dominus meus oculos regeneravit?

source: What kind of monster is this…
target: Qualis monstrum hoc est…

source: Is my role as his doctor merely to stop the bleeding and relieve the pain?
target: Num officium meum ut medicus eius sit tantum sanguinis effusionem sistere et dolorem levare?

source: Lumian paid no heed to the servant’s psychological turmoil.
target: Lumian non attendit animi turbam servi.

source: He returned to the master bedroom, drew back the curtains, laid out the paper, and picked up a dark‐black fountain pen.
target: Rediit ad cubiculum magistri, cortinas retrahevit, chartam explicavit, et calamus atri nigri elexit.

source: I’m still not cautious enough… He sighed suddenly.
target: Non adhuc satis cautus sum… Subito suspiravit.

source: After heeding the ice‐blue‐eyed Demons’ warning and preparing to depart Hanth Island with the Berries, Lumian refrained from promptly writing to Madam Magician.
target: Postquam monitionem daemonum oculis glacies caeruleis habentium auscultavit et paratus erat Insulam Hanth cum Berries relinquere, Lumian celeriter ad Dominam Magicam scribere non statuit.

source: He intended to observe the aftermath and wait until they were safely away from the port.
target: Propositum habebat eventus observare et exspectare, donec a portu tuto recessissent.

source: Unexpectedly, he had experienced such a terrifying and dangerous dream last night!
target: Inopinatius, talem somnium terribile et periculosum nocte praeterita experiebatur!

source: Initially suspecting that a Demon with ice‐blue eyes had lost control and covertly influenced him, Lumian later speculated that he might have been subtly corrupted when he observed the blood‐colored Demon and the pitch‐black liquid through the Mystery Prying Glasses.
target: Initio suspiciens daemonem oculis glacies caeruleis vim suam amittere et tacite influere, postea Lumian coniectavit se fortasse subtiliter corruptum esse, cum daemonem sanguineo colore et nigerrimum liquorem per specula inquisitiva mysteria viderat.

source: The corruption lay dormant until he slept, manifesting fully in his dream.
target: Corrumpatio quiescebat, donec dormivit, et in somnio plene se ostendebat.

source: Focusing his thoughts, he detailed everything witnessed and heard on Hanth Island.
target: Cogitationibus suis intentis, omnia in Insula Hanth conscripta et audita singillatim enarravit.

source: He replaced the name Naboredisley with the term Love Incantation.
target: Nomen Naboredisley verbo “Incantatio Amoris” substituit.

source: Concluding the letter, Lumian wrote sincerely, “Perhaps I’ve encountered too many Demons recently. I feel like I’ve accumulated too much corruption and want to undergo treatment.”
target: Epistulam concludens, Lumian sincero animo scribit: “Forsitan nuper nimis multos daemones expertus sim; videor nimis multam corruptelam congregasse et curam pati velle.”

source: Following that, Lumian conducted a ritual, summoning the doll messenger, and handed over the folded letter.
target: Postea, Lumian ritu perfunctus, nuntium pupae evocavit, et epistulam plicatam tradidit.

source: Accepting the letter with its right hand, the doll messenger covered its nose with its left palm and exclaimed, “You stepped on the world’s stinkiest thing!”
target: Epistulam dextro manu recipiens, nuntius pupae, sinistra manu nasum operiens, exclamat: “Calcavisti rem mundi maxime foetidissimam!”

source: “It stinks! It stinks!”
target: Fetet! Fetet!

source: “So dirty, so dirty!”
target: Tam sordida, tam sordida!

source: Swiftly grasping the letter between two fingers, the doll messenger vanished from the room.
target: Celeriter epistulam inter duo digitos prehendens, nuntius pupae ex conclavi evanuit.

source: Lumian waited briefly, but with no immediate response from Madam Magician, he decided to seek “treatment” elsewhere.
target: Lumian brevi exspectavit, sed responsum immediate a Domina Magica non receptum, statuit alibi “curam” quaerere.

source: His destination was the cathedral of the Church of Earth Mother in Port Hanth, where he had visited the day before.
target: Destinatio eius erat cathedralis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae in Portu Hanth, quam die praecedente visitaverat.

source: In the early morning, before the commencement of work, numerous believers gathered to listen to the preaching.
target: Mane, ante initium operis, multi fideles congregati sunt ad praedicationem audiendam.

source: The preacher, the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman from yesterday, expounded on a specific doctrine from the Holy Scripture.
target: Praedicator, clericus oculis glacies caeruleis heri notus, doctrinam certam ex Sacra Scriptura enarravit.

source: The concept that good and evil emanated from the same source, making them inseparable, was discussed.
target: Conceptus, quod bonum et malum ex eodem fonte emanarent, unde inseparabiles fierent, disputabatur.

source: The sermon emphasized promoting good and suppressing evil.
target: Praedicatio bonum promovendi et malum reprimendi extollita erat.

source: Isn’t it a little ironic to have this coming from a Demon like you? Lumian criticized and sat in the first row, listening casually.
target: Nonne parum ironicum est hoc a daemon tali, ut te? Lumian reprehendens in prima fila consedit, leviter audiens.

source: He soon sensed the cathedral’s vibrant vitality.
target: Mox cathedralis vitalitatem vigentem sensit.

source: Vegetation flourished, and mushrooms quietly sprouted.
target: Vegetatio floruit, et fungi tacite germinaverunt.

source: The scent of wheat and milk provided a calming atmosphere.
target: Odor tritici et lactis ambitum tranquillum afferebat.

source: Unconsciously, Lumian realized that his life had gained intensity.
target: Inopinato, Lumian sensit vitam suam maiorem intensitatem adeptam esse.

source: Each of the orthodox Churches has its own merits… he sighed silently.
target: Unaquaeque Ecclesia orthodoxa sua bona habet… ille silentio suspiravit.

source: After five to six minutes, the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman concluded his preaching and approached Lumian with a warm smile.
target: Post quinque ad sex minuta, clericus oculis glacies caeruleis praedicationem finivit et, cum amabili risu, ad Lumian accessit.

source: “Young people who are willing to listen to advice always have a bright future.
target: Iuvenes, qui consilium auscultare parati sunt, semper futurum clarum habent.

source: “Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
target: Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!

source: Lumian observed the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman retracting his raised hands.
target: Lumian vidit clericum oculis glacies caeruleis, qui manus elevatas recipiebat.

source: Is he hinting that it’s “satisfied” that I stopped inquiring, exploring the forest, and searching for someone with ice‐blue eyes since noon yesterday? Lumian considered, then looked at the clergyman before speaking.
target: Num insinuat se satisfactum esse quod desierim quaerere, silvam explorare, atque aliquem cum oculis glacies caeruleis, ex meridie heri, invenire? Lumian cogitavit, deinde ad clericum spectavit antequam loqui coepit.

source: “However, I had a terrifying dream last night and nearly died from it.”
target: “Attamen, heri nocte somnium terribile habevi et prope ex eo mortuus sum.”

source: “What dream?” the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman inquired warmly.
target: “Quod somnium?” clericus oculis glacies caeruleis calide quaesivit.

source: “Bishop, how should I address you?” Lumian asked, deferring from providing an immediate answer.
target: “Episcopus, quomodo te vocare debeam?” Lumian quaesivit, moram capiens praesens responsum dare.

source: “Newman,” the ice‐blue‐eyed clergyman announced its name in human society.
target: “Newman,” proclamat clericus oculis glacies caeruleis, nomen suum in societate humana.

source: Lumian briefly recounted the blood‐colored Demon in his dream, the pitch‐black liquid, the blurry figure, and the branches and tree warts.
target: Lumian brevi relatus est daemonem sanguineo colore in somnio suo, liquorem nigerrimum, figuram nebulosam, ac ramos et verrucas arborum.

source: He didn’t delve into the final injuries he had suffered.
target: Non enarravit vulnera ultima quae passa fuerat.

source: Bishop Newman listened quietly, gazing at Lumian for a few seconds.
target: Episcopus Newman silentio auscultavit, et per paucos secundos ad Lumian intuebatur.

source: “Are you willing to listen to my preaching?”
target: “Esne paratus praedicationem meam audire?”

source: “Sure,” Lumian agreed, curious about what the Ice‐blue‐eyed Demon had to say.
target: “Certe,” Lumian consentivit, curiosus quid daemon oculis glacies caeruleis dicere haberet.

source: Newman flipped open the Holy Bible in his arms and spoke in a magnetic voice, “There are two Abysses.
target: Newman Biblicam Sacram in brachiis suis aperuit et voce magnetica inquit: “Sunt duo abissi.

source: One is material, and the entrance is somewhere in the real world.
target: Unus est materialis, et introitus alicubi in mundo reali consistit.

source: The other is spiritual, and the entrance is deep in everyone’s hearts.
target: Alter est spiritualis, et introitus altus in corde omnium insidet.

source: Sometimes, these two Abysses are separated, but most of the time, they’re one.
target: Aliquando, hi duo abissi dividentur, sed plerumque unum videntur.

source: “Good intentions and evil intentions come from the same source.
target: Bonae et malae intentiones eodem fonte oriuntur.

source: It’s inevitable for us to harbor evil thoughts like jealousy, hatred, destruction, greed, harm, and arrogance.
target: Ineluctabiliter nobis evenit malas cogitationes sustentare, ut invidia, odium, destructio, avaritia, laesio, et superbia.

source: This is normal, not sinful.
target: Hoc normale est, non peccaminosum.

source: “However, if we act on jealousy, hatred, greed, and arrogance, killing someone—our souls will gradually sink into the Abyss.
target: Attamen, si invidia, odium, avaritiam, et superbiam aggrediemur, aliquem interficientes, animae nostrae paulatim in abissum labefactabuntur.

source: “When the time comes, one can only repent to the Mother, just like this.
target: Cum tempus venit, solum possumus Matri paenitere, hoc modo.

source: “Merciful Mother, I have fallen into the Abyss of evil…”
target: “Miseranda Mater, in abissum mali caderim…”

source: Lumian listened quietly, grasping the essence of Bishop Newman’s words.
target: Lumian silentio auscultavit, essentiam verborum Episcopi Newman capiens.

source: He acknowledged his mistake rooted in arrogance.
target: Errorem suum, in superbia radicatum, agnovit.

source: His earlier ventures, marked by a proactive approach and a lack of major problems, had led him to underestimate the concealed perils of high-level matters.
target: Praeterita incepta, proactiva mente et defectu maximi incommodi insignita, eum ad pericula celata rerum gravium subestimanda duxerunt.

source: Standing up, Lumian raised his hands.
target: Stans, Lumian manus suas attollit.

source: “I understand. Praise the Earth, praise the Mother of All Things!”
target: “Intelligo. Laudate Terram, laudate Matrem Omnium Rerum!”

source: Newman nodded in satisfaction.
target: Newman cum satisfactio annuit.

source: Returning to the Berries, Lumian read the reply, neatly folded into a square.
target: Rediens ad Berries, Lumian responsum legit, in quadratum arcte plicatum.

source: The letter contained spirit world coordinates and a concise directive: “Put an end to the matter on Hanth Island.
target: Epistula coordinata mundi spiritualis et mandatum concisum continebat: “Exstinguite rem in Insula Hanth.

source: Find time to seek treatment here.”
target: Invenite tempus hic ad curationem quaerendam.”
